notes.title: Patch 7: Infinite Momentum
notes.notes:
Hey heroes!

Major updates and announcements are finally here! We bring you infinite momentum, a machine gun, new rewards, better graphics, and more. Not to mention, we're part of 3 showcases this month, offering exclusive trailers and even more updates in the coming weeks.



This patch includes:

Infinite Momentum - chain together slide, grapple, jump, wallrun, and railgrind to build momentum, now with unlimited max speed and therefore damage multiplier (if you don't crash)

Machine Gun - fully automatic rifle with rapid fire and some spread

New rewards - jumping back in for one more run is even easier and more rewarding, skipping the intro tutorials and a streamlined post-run progression after every run

Tuned enemy health and balanced player weapons

Major graphics update to enhance the retro sci-fi style

Over 100 bugfixes and gameplay improvements
Wishlist GUNSTOPPABLE![previewyoutube="O_YnFxpRqk0;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch 5: Augment System
notes.notes:
Hey heroes!

We hope you're enjoying the game so far. Get ready to enjoy the newest feature in Patch 5: the Augment System! Unlock and equip permanent Augments like the Gravity Boots and Claw Machine. This patch also includes improvements to combat and bugfixes.

New Augment System - purchase augments in the black market and equip up to 3 for new build synergies like grapple refresh on kill and low gravity mode

Doubled base ammo clip size for every gun

Decreased enemy health for all enemy types

Added discovered upgrades list to main menu

Improved animations for enemies attacking and getting hit

notes.title: Patch 4: Momentum and Gunplay
notes.notes:
Hey heroes!

Play the fourth patch of Gunstoppable, now with faster momentum chaining, more satisfying gunplay, and a more intuitive hex upgrade system.

Made gunplay more satisfying - every weapon now has unique/improved animations, sounds, screen shake, and crosshair effects

Improved hex upgrade system to be more intuitive

Increased speed of slide, grapple, railgrind, and wallrun

Improved momentum preservation when jumping

Reduced grapple cooldown and fixed fail grapple triggering cooldown

Potential fix for "one enemy remaining" bug in space tower

Improved low graphics mode

Other bugfixes and improvements
